values.note: $32 a night at every water/electric site in 2026, 2027 and 2028.

Pay through recreation.gov or the gate attendant. Bookable through the day of arrival. 3-night minimum on holiday weekends; 14 nights in any rolling 30 days. Gates 7 am - 10 pm, code given at check-in. Boat ramp and courtesy dock for registered campers only.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232749 (fee description 'All payments and fees will occur through recreation.gov or the on-site Gate Attendant'; facility_rules minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 per rolling 30 days, reservationCutOff 0; gate and boat-ramp text), read 2026-10-29

summary: recreation.gov + RIDB: USACE Savannah District campground on the Little River arm of Thurmond Lake near Mistletoe SP; 80 sites (79 reservable water/50 A, 24-65 ft, all fit 23 ft, 37 pull-through), showers, dump; $32 a night 2026-2028 (confirmed); open about Apr - mid-Sep; 3-night holiday minimum, 14-night max. Pin is 80 m from rec.gov's facility point. AWH note kept verbatim (rec.gov: 'on the shoreline of the J Strom Thurmond lake'; 'All shorelines adjacent to campsites are public property'). Operated by USACE directly (not commercially managed); not FCFS.
